positions.title: Business Systems Analyst
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
- Built reliable and scalable solutions to automate time-consuming internal processes including external contractor onboarding, contractor payment processing, marketing automation, and user interface testing.

- Succeeded in the configuration, migration, and administration of a new CRM system with tens of thousands of records without disrupting sales operations, twice!

- Deployed and administered business systems including G Suite, Slack, Jira, Airtable, 3CX, Help Scout, GitHub, AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Salesforce, HubSpot, 1Password Teams, and more.

- Utilized databases, data warehouses, and APIs to aggregate business intelligence data into dashboards for company leadership to monitor various metrics and KPIs.

- Served as the primary technical liaison between software developers, vendors, customers, and business stakeholders.

positions.title: Product Development Specialist
positions.description:
- Helped to conceptualize, develop, and launch an online learning platform that is now utilized by some of the largest school districts in the country and over 70,000 educators around the world.

- Managed external software development teams, ensuring the timely delivery of projects and requests while avoiding scope creep.

- Implemented continuous integration and delivery into the internal software development process, saving the development team around 35 hours each month in testing and deployment time.

- Taught educators how to use new technologies and integrate them into their schools/classrooms at EdTech conferences.

positions.title: IT Manager/Consultant
positions.description:
- Provided both on-site and remote managed IT services and support to K-12 schools. Services included networking (wired and wireless), physical security (cameras, access control, etc.), server configuration and administration, VoIP (PBX), Identity and Access Management (IAM), Student Information Systems (SIS), Learning Management Systems (LMS), Mobile Device Management (MDM), Chrome Management (Chrome OS), and much more.

- Advised school/district technology teams working on 1:1 initiatives on effective deployment and implementation strategies.

- Developed and delivered EdTech-focused professional development lessons to educators in schools and districts with new 1:1 initiatives.

positions.title: Technology Director
positions.description:
- Managed all information systems and services for over 450 students, faculty, and staff with a continuous improvement approach.

- Headed a team of school administration, faculty, and industry experts in writing a grant proposal to fund a 1:1 initiative.

- Led the development, deployment, and implementation of a million-dollar 1:1 initiative funded by a grant awarded to the school by the state of Utah.

positions.title: Technology Coordinator
positions.description:
- Led a pioneering deployment of Chromebooks to replace an aging mobile cart of Windows laptops and classroom desktop computers.

- Managed the transition from externally-managed IT to internally-managed IT as the school gained independence from its former school district.

- Provided weekly technology training to educators, helping them discover new ways to integrate technology into their classrooms.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
- Introduced Google Apps for Education and managed the migration of all faculty and staff accounts from a legacy Microsoft Exchange Server for added storage and improved security.

- Developed and implemented a plan to create and administer 250 student accounts to improve collaboration among students.

- Trained faculty, staff, and students on how to use Google Apps (Gmail, Google Docs, Google Calendar, Google Sites, etc.) as part of a change management strategy.

positions.title: Professional DJ/MC
positions.description: Highly requested DJ at weddings, fundraisers, and other events because of my ability to become the life of the party and get people dancing.
